import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Product distribution
product_counts = data['product'].value_counts()
axes[0, 0].bar(product_counts.index, product_counts.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Product Distribution')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by customer age group
age_totals = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].barh(age_totals.index, age_totals.values, color='#D2691E')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Sales by Age Group')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 3. Payment method distribution
payment_counts = data['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[0, 2].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=['#CD853F', '#DEB887'])
axes[0, 2].set_title('Payment Method Distribution')

# 4. Size distribution
size_counts = data['size'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color='#BC8F8F')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Size Distribution')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Size')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
takeaway_counts = data['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'}).value_counts()
axes[1, 1].pie(takeaway_counts.values, labels=takeaway_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=['#F4A460', '#DAA520'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in')

# 6. Sales over time (hourly)
data['hour'] = data['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
hourly_sales = data.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 2].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
                markersize=8, color='#8B4513')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Sales by Hour')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
